rings.name: Adopt
rings.description: Safe to use in production. Proven internally with clear value.

entries.title: Open WebUI

timeline.description: Core chat capability via Ollama inference

entries.title: RAG Knowledge Assistants
entries.description: Retrieval-augmented generation assistants for enterprise knowledge Q&A. Built with Qdrant vector store + Ollama embeddings.

timeline.description: Piloting with internal documentation

entries.title: Claude (Anthropic)

entries.description: Speech-to-text, voice assistants, image understanding. Requires specialized models and infrastructure.

entries.description: AI-driven operations monitoring, log analysis, and anomaly detection for infrastructure health.

entries.description: Self-hosted LLM inference server. GPU-accelerated, supports GGUF models. Foundation for all local AI capabilities.

timeline.description: Core model serving infrastructure

entries.description: Open-source LLM family from Alibaba. Primary instruction model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct) in the stack.
